canonical_json.scientific_payload_newline: none; canonical files use one LF after the JSON payload
canonical_json.arrays: already ordered by the applicable frozen ordering rule

shared_identity.string_normalization: Unicode NFKC, then Unicode NFC, trim leading/trailing whitespace, collapse each consecutive whitespace run to one ASCII space, casefold
shared_identity.record_id: extb_rec_v2_<sha256(record_domain + NUL + family_id + NUL + condition_id + NUL + record_role)>

selection_and_serialization.candidate_selection: ascending SHA-256(order_domain + NUL + canonical_source_tuple); canonical_source_tuple is the tie-break
selection_and_serialization.source_selection: retain the first 220 eligible unique source families per task
selection_and_serialization.condition_assignment: selected source rank // 22 selects c01 through c10 in listed order for spatial and mereological sources
selection_and_serialization.within_condition_index: selected source rank % 22 + 1 for spatial and mereological sources

spatial.argument_orientation: ARG_A is the first generated argument and ARG_B the second; label is ARG_A relative to ARG_B
spatial.eligibility: valid JSON object, allowed label, and unique canonical source tuple

quantitative.source_identity: deterministic programmatic source; no external text source
quantitative.numeric_domain: A in [11,32], B in [-5,4] and therefore within the inherited V1 domain [11,32] and [-17,4]
quantitative.zero_and_negative_policy: zero and negative B are allowed; no -0; no plus sign
quantitative.pair_uniqueness: the normalized (numeric_a, numeric_b) pair occurs in at most one source family across the entire quantitative task
quantitative.canonical_numeric_format: base-10 ASCII digits, minus sign only for negative values, no leading zero
quantitative.selection_note: all 220 eligible unique pairs are hash ordered and retained; condition and split are assigned from selected rank, never from observed outcomes

mereological.pointer_direction: normalize both meronym and holonym pointers to ARG_A=part/member/substance and ARG_B=whole
mereological.lemma_normalization: shared string normalization; retain non-empty lemma strings and source identity form
mereological.surface_lemma_rule: replace each source lemma underscore with exactly one ASCII space only for rendered surface text, then apply shared whitespace normalization
mereological.synset_selection: noun synsets with at least one allowed pointer; lexicographically first valid normalized lemma per endpoint
mereological.ambiguity: retain all distinct valid pointer edges; no manual sense preference
mereological.deduplication: deduplicate canonical (part_lemma, whole_lemma, normalized_relation_type, source_synset_offset, target_synset_offset) tuples

rendering_inputs.duplicate_scope: global exact-byte and normalized-text rejection across all records; no within-family exemption
